changelog.summary: Fixes the 0.8.0-alpha.3 desktop packaging defect that aborted the installed app with QMS_STARTUP_FAILED: the .deb now contains and verifies every engine runtime dependency, including fflate. The release gate extracts the built .deb, starts the packaged engine and performs a real engine.info JSON-RPC handshake, and proves it detects a removed dependency.

desktop.changelog: Packaging-only fix. desktop/engine-package now declares fflate 0.8.3 and the engine runtime also stages src/config.js (dynamically imported by compat.loadLegacyConfig). prepare-engine resolves the complete import graph against an isolated copy of the staged tree and fails the build on any unresolved import. release:prepare runs the extracted-.deb JSON-RPC handshake and a missing-dependency negative test.

publisher.changelog: Unchanged in this release; the Publisher artifact is byte-identical to 0.8.0-alpha.2.

cms.changelog: Unchanged in this release; the Generic CMS artifact is byte-identical to 0.8.0-alpha.3 owner-Admin fix.
